proposition: In the second apology Ibn Turka admits having received a khirqa-yi tabarruk from a great Sufi master before going abroad to study, and, on returning after some fifteen years, finding that master's disciples antinomian; a meeting between them became a shouting match.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, Nafsat al-Masdur II (ca. 832-35/1429-32, after exile)
mediation.note: less guarded and angrier in tone (MK), but still an account for the court
